supporting_evidence: H4 and H1 structure bullish (D1 not opposing)
sell-side liquidity swept and closed back above
price in discount of the last swing range
price inside a bullish FVG/Order Block zone
contradicting_evidence: M15 structure bearish

plan.order_rationale: price already reacting at a zone/liquidity sweep: enter at the next open
plan.stop_method: ATR-based (1.5 x ATR14); structure level shown for reference
confirmation: M15 bar closes above the decision close with no opposing displacement
spread/ATR stays below 0.20
invalidation: M15 close below 4249.43 (last confirmed swing) before entry
H4/H1 structure turns against the trade
cancel_conditions: next bar gaps beyond 0.5 ATR from reference

staged_entry.note: only when setup quality >= 4; total risk unchanged (each tranche carries half the risk budget)

target.why_not_every_move: A trade is proposed only with HTF confluence, >=3 aligned evidence items, no blocking execution/volatility flag and a clear opposing level distance.
